notes.title: Steam Next Fest Retropy Live Stream
Retropy Pro and Retropy Lite COMING SOON
notes.notes: COMING SOON, the PRO and LITE games will be available on October 22, 2024. This is right after October Next Fest, so we are excited for you to be able to try our game for free! As always, feedback is greatly appreciated.

notes.title: Increased Difficulty and New Puzzles
notes.notes:
UPDATES:

- New puzzles and objects are coming to Retropy! (pictured below)
- You’re invited to Steam’s October Next Fest, where we will be featured from October 14th - 21st!
- The game will be released for the first time on Steam VR on October 22nd, 2024
- We are excited to collaborate with a dementia therapy and support group, Meaningful Moments, as September is Alzheimer’s Awareness Month

notes.title: New Puzzle Objects!
notes.notes:
Including a vintage car and camera, we are working to slice and upload more objects to puzzle. We have already uploaded several to the Beta build, and they are planned to be tested in the coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172809/5e9ea7dc2560a330e5d5e47dfea77017a803ae6e.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW DEV LOG UPDATE: PREPARING FOR DEMO
notes.notes:
- 🌟 New environments
    - A variety of new environments and virtual backgrounds, including dark skies, galaxies and more!
    - Regarding feedback about the Default environment, you can now choose from an array of environments
- Common Issues
    - A few spelling errors and main menu interface bugs were fixed.

Next Update Plans

- 🧩 User Feedback and Current Tasks
    - Thank you for 600 test downloads!
    - User Interface improvements
    - Tutorial Mode
    - New Objects and greater amounts of puzzle pieces (100)

🧩 Dev Message 🧩

Thank you for following along with us on this journey, and we hope you can stay while we implement your changes. Your input is very important to us, and we will continue working hard to make the best VR puzzle game possible. Thank you!
